name: Swiggy ₹1,200: the normal case

blocks.text: Which card should I pay with?
Pay with HSBC Live+: earns ₹120 on ₹1,200 at Swiggy. That is ₹60 more than Millennia.

items.meta: 5% on Amazon, Swiggy, Zomato and 7 more

msgs.what: Typed, picked from suggestions, or read from a UPI QR code.
Merchant text and amount; channel is optional (Auto uses the merchant's usual channel).
Exact alias, then fuzzy match, then the QR's merchant code; confidence high/medium/low.

msgs.l: cap used this period, available credit
msgs.what: Per card: how much of each cap the logged payments used in the current month/cycle, and available credit after the pool's other cards.
Most specific rule wins (merchant > category > catch-all), then exclusions, minimum amount, caps, stacked bonuses.
msgs.code:
Live+: rule accelerated 10% → 12000 paise
Millennia: rule online_10 5% → 6000 paise

msgs.what: Owner decision D10: the model chooses, the engine calculates. It gets each usable card's now, later, month and the differences, already formatted, plus bank-offer savings. No user id; the merchant text is wrapped as data. Measured live on 10 Oct: median 1.5 s (2.6 s with a strict schema, so strict is off; the card is checked in code).
One tool call. The card must be a usable candidate; any rupee amount in the reason must be one of the supplied figures, otherwise the engine's template explains the choice.
decided_by says whether the model or the rules chose. The rupee figures are the engine's either way.

note: Measured live: model median 1.5 s, strict schema off
